fullContentHtml:
BHU School Admission CHS/SET Result 2026 - Complete Details

BHU School Admission CHS/SET Result 2026. Candidates who appeared in the examination can now check their result and download the scorecard from the official website. The last date to apply is 20/03/2026. Check important dates, application fee, eligibility criteria and official links below.

Important Dates

  • Start Date : 20/02/2026
  • Last Date : 20/03/2026
  • Last Date Pay Fees : 20/03/2026
  • SET Admit Card Released : 16/04/2026
  • SET Exam Date : 22-26 April 2026
  • Download Admit Card : Click Here

Application Fee

  • Start Date : 20/02/2026
  • Last Date : 20/03/2026
  • Last Date Pay Fees : 20/03/2026
  • Through Entrance Test : General / OBC / EWS : 800/-SC/ ST  :550/-
  • School Admission LKG, Nursery, Class 1 & Class 6 : Age Calculate as on 31/03/2026
  • School Entrance Test SET Class 9 & Class 11 : Age Calculate as on 31/03/2026

How to Check Result

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the result / scorecard link.
  3. Enter your application number / roll number and date of birth / password.
  4. Click on submit to view your result.
  5. Download and take a printout of the scorecard for future reference.
